#! /bin/bash

echo "Looking for any time directories without results (e.g. stray functionObjectProperties files, see issue #26 on GitHub)..."

cd Fluid
for f in [0-9]* [0-9]*.[0-9]*; do
	if ! [ -f $f/U ] && ! [ -f $f/T ]; then
		rm -rfv $f
	fi
done
if [ -d processor0 ]; then
	for g in processor*; do
		cd $g
		for f in [0-9]* [0-9]*.[0-9]*; do
			if ! [ -f $f/U ] && ! [ -f $f/T ]; then
				rm -rfv $f
			fi
		done
		cd ..
	done
fi
cd ..
